_comment: Card Q3 (docs/SPEC_clock_temporal_anchor.md §3 pass 1) — the MEASUREMENT arm.
The internal golden63 1 h posture, the anchor OFF, with the prior-residual
census's `clk` family armed.  Trace-only: the product is byte-identical to the
base, so this arm is simultaneously the G0 OFF-path denominator at 1 h.
WHAT IT MEASURES.  The census standardizes the clock carry's predicted
residual by fold_var - post_var, which is Var(x_hat - mu) EXACTLY, and keeps a
quantile ladder of |t| plus a per-family sigma0.  Two numbers come out:
(1) sigma0_clk locates the BINDING KNEE.  Non-binding: the realized
dispersion is data-set, so sigma0 = sqrt((sigma_true^2 + R)/(q*dt)) < 1
and falls as q rises.  Binding: sigma0 -> sqrt(1 + sigma_true^2/R) ~ 1,
INDEPENDENT of q.  So sigma0 = 1 marks the knee exactly, from data.
Expected near q*dt ~ sigma_w^2 = 8.5e-3, i.e. q ~ 2.8e-4 -- to be
MEASURED, not assumed (the armed carry here is 1e-3).
(2) the |t| LADDER is the null distribution the guard threshold k is read
off.  Target trip rate ~1-2 network-wide per hour on a quiet day; the
CLK-R calibration anchor is that 16 sigma produced ~7 marks/h and 106
consumer epochs > 20 m, so the rate discipline is the binding constraint,
not the sigma count.
The clk family's e is COMMON-MODE REMOVED per constellation before
standardizing (unlike pb/cb): the clock is the one carried family with a free
per-epoch gauge, so the raw residual would report the gauge on every satellite
(standing invariant #5).
FRESH lineage; run alone.
